title: Pump, Tape, Phaser, Freeze
thisBuild: Four new effects in the FX strip: Pump (ducks the sound on every beat, the sidechain feel), Tape (warmth and a slow wow), Phase (a sweeping phaser) and Freeze (push it past halfway and the sound holds right where it is).
Pump shows by default; Faders (Menu, then a fader, or the strip's picker) adds Tape, Phase and Freeze.
Pump, Tape and Phaser are also LFO targets and XY targets, so a wave or your finger can move them. Every fader records with Rec on and maps to a MIDI knob.
watch: Pump on a pad or bass over a kick loop: does it breathe in time?
Freeze on a vocal or a long sample: does it hold smoothly, or does it buzz?
Play hard with these on: does the lag readout (Pro looks) or the feel creep?
limits: Freeze holds samples; on synths it does nothing yet.
I measured the engine with all four on sixteen pads at once and it keeps up, but on a phone, heavy use costs more than before. Tell me if it crackles.
